purpose: Finite-confidence inventory study; primary runs fixed after labelled implementation pilots
model: Projected Euler Gaussian regression with observed regulator

common_protocol.stopping_rule: Exact fixed-Gaussian-prior mixture inversion with conservative adaptive rectangle cover
common_protocol.resource_guard: At each Euler step, attenuate preservation to enforce cumulative energy <= B*time, with zero initial credit
common_protocol.oracle_status: Uses the true parameter for sampling design only; reference, not an implementable learner

reporting: Cumulative energy, operating cost, realized energy/time
No optional removal of unfavorable cells
limits: Fixed design precision does not implement the asymptotic oracle schedule
Time-step refinement does not prove a continuous-time error bound
Guarded sampling differs from the unguarded stationary library program
